title: Hearing on tenant harassment against immigrants and no-harassment certification
summary: The City Council will hold a joint hearing examining tenant harassment targeting immigrant New Yorkers and the city's Certification of No Harassment pilot program, with testimony expected from HPD, DOB and the Mayor's Office of Immigrant Affairs. The committees will also consider Introduction 839, which would make the Certification of No Harassment pilot program permanent and add criteria for which buildings must be included. The hearing background notes that nearly half of New Yorkers live in immigrant households and that undocumented residents face higher poverty and overcrowding rates.
